questions.q: What did Tita's mother do after hearing she was going to the neighbouring village?
questions.explain: Tita ironed all her clothes to please her mother.

questions.q: Why did Tita's mother praise her after she ironed the clothes?
choices: she was pleased with her work

questions.q: What did Tita do with her saree?
